per_claim.claim_text: The UK Strategic Road Network carries approximately one-third of all road traffic and two-thirds of freight tonne-kilometres , yet its adaptive capacity to changing climate conditions is under strain.
per_claim.source_quote: Distances travelled by vehicles are likely to increase nationally and globally, with global tonne-kilometres of freight movement expected to approximately double between 2020 and 2050
per_claim.reasoning: None of the claim's key phrases appear anywhere in the paper: 'Strategic Road Network', 'one-third of all road traffic', 'two-thirds of freight', 'adaptive capacity to changing climate', 'under strain' all return zero hits across all 19 pages. The closest semantic passage (page 13) discusses global freight tonne-kilometres doubling by 2050 — a global statistic unrelated to the UK SRN and making no statement about adaptive capacity. The claim appears to originate from a UK-specific source (e.g. Highways England/National Highways reports) not cited in this paper.
